object_description: linear compact extension with a smaller side volume
design_condition: The compact extension is aligned with the existing college composition, using the sports hall as a scale reference, raising the classroom building while preserving the established hierarchy and outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The connecting volume takes the size of the sports hall as a reference and is skilfully integrated into the composition.

position.rationale: Central elongated connection is visible between the larger mass and smaller side volume across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The raised classroom building retains the main volume hierarchy.

position.rationale: Elevated classroom mass is identifiable above the lower connecting and side volumes.

positive.statement: The unitary facade treatment gives coherence and a new identity to the college.

position.rationale: Facade assignment is anchored to the prominent south-facing envelope of the elongated main building.

positive.statement: The entrance hall provides multiple access routes and numerous possibilities of use.

position.rationale: The smaller eastern volume provides the most plausible surface location for the entrance hall.

positive.statement: The provision of light on each distribution level improves the spatiality of the platforms in a simple but effective way.

position.rationale: Platforms are assigned to the mid-height circulation zone of the raised classroom building.

positive.statement: The compactness preserves access qualities and as much space as possible for sports and outdoor activities.

position.rationale: Open-space benefit is anchored to the less occupied western and northern surroundings.

positive.statement: The reorganization of sports areas, play areas and paths generates quality gathering places and varied walks.

position.target: sports areas, play areas and paths
position.rationale: Gathering and circulation improvements are distributed through the open site edge around the compact masses.

positive.statement: The treatment of the developments promotes biodiversity and rich, varied local vegetation.

position.rationale: Vegetation is placed on the peripheral open ground beyond the western building footprint.

negative.statement: The sanitary facilities in the smaller volume are insufficient, and a group room is lacking on each floor.

position.rationale: Interior shortcomings are approximated within the smaller eastern volume, whose rooms are not distinguishable externally.

negative.statement: The unitary facade treatment still needs clarification in its development.

position.rationale: Clarification concerns the visible south facade of the elongated principal volume.
